description: Water Main Breaks in the City of Los Angeles Each Month is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Number of recorded water leaks by months in the City of Los Angeles. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure & Service Requests. Its tags are broken pipe, water leaks. The table has 2 columns. The portal shows 2018-02-08 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
